package repository

import (
	"context"
	"time"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-learning-planner/internal/domain"
)

type CoursePlanRepository interface {
	CreateOrGet(context.Context, domain.CoursePlanRequest) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, bool, error)
	GetForStudent(context.Context, string, string) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, error)
	ClaimNext(context.Context, string, time.Time, time.Time) (domain.CoursePlanRequest, error)
	RenewClaim(context.Context, string, string, time.Time, time.Time) error
	ResolveLearningPath(context.Context, string, string, string, time.Time) error
	CheckpointLearningPathCommand(context.Context, domain.CoursePlanRequest, string, time.Time) error
	Complete(context.Context, domain.CoursePlanRequest, string, time.Time) error
	Retry(context.Context, domain.CoursePlanRequest, string, time.Time, time.Time) error
	Fail(context.Context, domain.CoursePlanRequest, string, string, time.Time) error
}

type GoalGraphRepository interface {
	GetPublishedGoalGraph(context.Context, string) (domain.GoalGraph, error)
}

// ReadinessGoalGraphRepository performs a closed, exact published graph lookup.
// It is intentionally separate from the legacy course-planning graph port.
type ReadinessGoalGraphRepository interface {
	GetPublishedGoalGraphExact(context.Context, string, string, string) (domain.GoalGraph, error)
}

type PolicyRepository interface {
	GetActivePolicyBundle(context.Context) (domain.PolicyBundle, error)
}
